kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
اقطوطيت (form XII)
# اِقْطَوْطَيْتُ (iqṭawṭaytu) /iq.tˤaw.tˤaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِقْطَوْطَى (iqṭawṭā)
# اِقْطَوْطَيْتَ (iqṭawṭayta) /iq.tˤaw.tˤaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِقْطَوْطَى (iqṭawṭā)
# اِقْطَوْطَيْتِ (iqṭawṭayti) /iq.tˤaw.tˤaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِقْطَوْطَى (iqṭawṭā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
